state: Phase 01 — Initial literature discovery completed; verification continues
summary: The first exploratory academic search produced ten retained publication records across the funding-call priorities. Three published full-text articles were inspected in relevant sections; one additional paper's preprint was inspected alongside its published record. Other evidence is provisional pending full-text review and student confirmation. No final research question or gap has been selected.

reports.title: Update 04 — First exploratory literature search
reports.searchLog: Multi-query scholarly web searches across all five funding-call priorities; publisher, university, PubMed/PMC, DBLP and arXiv records consulted. Ten publication records retained for this first batch. Overall search-result denominator not available.
reports.findings: Verified research records address relationship development, reported benefits and risks, disruptions and memory/design interventions. Published work directly addresses safe endings and memory controls; originality requires more precise comparison.
reports.limitations: Publication-record verification is not student confirmation. Some sources are abstract-only or indexed excerpts; correction/retraction checks and full-text review remain incomplete. No final gap or method selected.
reports.nextSteps: Acquire restricted full texts, expand search and citation tracing, assess design evaluations, and compare candidate research directions.

reports.title: Update 03 — Extended research authorised
reports.findings: Preparation and scope definition are complete. The student has authorised extended academic research when dedicated Deep Research is unavailable. All other academic verification and ethical requirements remain applicable.
reports.limitations: This update records a research-method decision, not an academic finding. No screened or verified publications have yet been recorded.
reports.nextSteps: Begin exploratory literature searches across the five funding-call priorities. Record actual database access, query strings, source details and verification outcomes.

reports.title: Update 02 — Earlier research access check
reports.findings: Dedicated research access was unavailable at the time of this check.
reports.limitations: No academic literature findings were verified during this check.
reports.nextSteps: Superseded by Update 03: extended academic research is now authorised.

reports.title: Update 01 — Research protocol and evidence status (planning only)
reports.findings: Document review completed: the official brief confirms five research priorities, a 6–12 month proposed project duration and a maximum funding limit of £120,000. This is an assessment-brief finding, not an academic literature finding.
reports.searchLog: Planned academic discovery: anthropomorphism and conversational AI; AI companion memory and attachment; emotional reliance and dependency; AI companion model updates and loss; persona portability and responsible transitions. No actual database search logs have been received.
reports.limitations: No external literature findings or source counts were verified during planning.
reports.nextSteps: Superseded by Update 03: proceed with authorised extended academic research.
